Start here — it's clickable.

Tap a mark or a row to go World → Italy → Alto Piemonte, and the breadcrumb to come back out. The leading direction is A and C together: an atlas you drill into a country plate.
Three treatments on one axis: how much real geography, versus how legible the names are. B gives up the map entirely and is the best pure learning tool — say so if that's what you'd rather have.
